rules.name: Item 36 — Minimum Duration Check
rules.description: Item 36 requires a consultation of at least 20 minutes. Flags claims where the recorded Pracsoft appointment duration is below 20 minutes, or where consecutive Item 36 claims compress more than 3 per hour. Also triggers when a provider's Item 36 proportion exceeds 2× peer average for 30+ consecutive days.

rules.name: Item 23 / 36 Ratio Anomaly
rules.description: Detects providers where the ratio of Item 36 (long) to Item 23 (standard) claims sits more than 2 standard deviations from peer cohort. The classic Provider Review trigger — a high-Item-36 provider with a correspondingly low Item 23 rate is a statistical outlier that Services Australia data-matching flags automatically during provider selection for review.

rules.name: Item 44 — After-Hours Timestamp Validation
rules.description: Checks consultation timestamp from Pracsoft against the MBS after-hours window. Flags claims where the appointment record places the consultation inside ordinary hours but Item 44 was billed. Also flags providers with Item 44 usage significantly above peer cohort.

rules.name: CDM Item 721 Co-Claim Eligibility
rules.description: GP Management Plan (Item 721) requires the patient to have a chronic condition expected to last ≥6 months. Validates frequency rules (max once per 12 months unless exceptional circumstance) and prevents 721/723 co-claim within minimum interval. Also checks that a valid Item 723 TCA is in Pracsoft before any allied health MBS billing occurs under that plan.

rules.name: Allied Health — TCA Referral Verification
rules.description: Before any allied health practitioner bills under MBS via a Team Care Arrangement, MedicalGuard cross-references the billing event against the referring GP's Pracsoft records. A current Item 721 and a valid Item 723 referral must both be present and in-date.

rules.name: Item 2713 — Mental Health Plan Requirement
rules.description: Mental health consultations (Items 2710/2712/2713) require a documented Mental Health Treatment Plan or must be appropriately linked to a plan in Pracsoft. Validates that psychology referrals (Items 80110–80180) are within the 10-session annual limit per patient.

rules.name: Duplicate Claim Detection
rules.description: Same patient + same item + same provider + same day. The highest-confidence indicator of inadvertent double-billing. MedicalGuard checks against Pracsoft records in real time. Optional pre-submit block prevents the duplicate reaching Medicare at all.

rules.name: 80/20 Rule — Daily Volume Monitor
rules.description: Section 82A of the Health Insurance Act: providing 80+ services on 20 or more days in 12 months triggers compulsory Professional Services Review. MedicalGuard runs a daily volume count for every provider with a 90-day forward projection.

rules.name: Telehealth — Existing Patient Requirement
rules.description: Telehealth phone consultations require the patient to have been seen face-to-face in the same practice within the prior 12 months (with limited exceptions). Validates against Pracsoft visit history for every telehealth claim.
